## Summary

Describe the scoped change and why it is needed.

## Security and contract impact

- [ ] No tool, transport, authorization, data exposure, dependency, or
      supported-platform change.
- [ ] Any material boundary change has an accepted ADR and updated contract/security
      docs.

## Verification

- [ ] `pnpm check`
- [ ] `pnpm build`
- [ ] Relevant Extension Host and exact-artifact tests
- [ ] No generated output, secret, source content, token, or private path is committed
